purpose: Controlled predictive baseline for joint unseen-geology generalization across the prospectively frozen 3x3 rate/BHP control grid.

experimental_design.comparison_principle: Hold recurrent architecture/objective fixed relative to the earlier EXP-MC1 baseline; change the physical learning dataset and control-space coverage, not model capacity.
experimental_design.TRAIN: 18 complete Foundation Cases: geologies 0026-0027, all 3x3 rate/BHP combinations
experimental_design.VALIDATION: 9 complete Foundation Cases: geology0028, all 3x3 rate/BHP combinations
experimental_design.LOCKED_OOD_TEST: 9 complete Foundation Cases: geology0029, all 3x3 rate/BHP combinations; unavailable to training/selection and opened only by the separately frozen one-touch evaluation protocol
experimental_design.claim_scope: unseen-geology generalization inside the prospectively frozen 350-650 t/day and 1800-2200 psi control grid; NOT extrapolation beyond control bounds

determinism.note: Hardware/library nondeterminism must be recorded if exact bitwise determinism cannot be achieved; it does not authorize a protocol change.

model.name: V16D_EXP_CS1
model.architecture_lineage: C20 / EXP-MC1 two-layer recurrent predictive baseline

objective.reason: EXP-CS1 is the controlled predictive baseline. Physics-informed loss variants, if studied later, require a new prospective experiment contract and may not be selected using locked OOD results.

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.other_parameters: TensorFlow/Keras defaults unless explicitly serialized by the future training runner

sampling.case_weighting: equal per sequence; each case contributes exactly 9x1078 streamline-time sequences

loading.strategy: streaming/memory-safe per-case NPZ loading through deterministic generator/tf.data
loading.VALIDATION_XY_access: allowed only for validation objective/checkpoint selection

checkpoint.ties: retain first checkpoint achieving the minimum under framework callback semantics

postfit.next_after_successful_training: freeze final one-touch evaluator source/checkpoint binding before OOD_OPENED.lock may be created

failure_policy.serialization_failure: repair/recover already-frozen best weights; do not retrain merely to repair serialization
failure_policy.OOM: repair loading/execution without changing model/objective; if batch size must change, freeze D33 revision BEFORE retry
failure_policy.interruption: a restart/resume strategy must preserve the exact D33 experiment identity; do not silently change seed, dataset, architecture, optimizer, or validation rule
failure_policy.training_nan_or_nonfinite: stop and diagnose; do not inspect OOD and do not relax scientific/data gates
failure_policy.validation_result_is_poor: report it; do not open OOD and do not modify this experiment retroactively

prohibited: batch-size changes without a prospective protocol revision
direct rate/BHP channel insertion in EXP-CS1
retraining solely because validation performance is disappointing
